event.title: docs(specs): remove the specs of the build and check scripts
event.author: gorkma
event.body:
## Summary

Predictable Code now analyses four code folders only: `src`, `mcp`, `scripts/render` and `scripts/runtime`. The build and check scripts are project tooling and are out of scope. Their specs were written before that choice (#5) and nothing verifies them any more, so they would go stale.

```diff
 specs/
 ├── _areas.md                      # drops the "Validation Checks" line: no spec uses it now
 ├── mcp/
 ├── src/
 └── scripts/
     ├── render/                    # ships in the package as pieces/render: stays
     ├── runtime/                   # ships as pieces/runtime/runtime.js: stays
-    ├── build-mcp-firebase.ts.spec.md
-    ├── build-mcp-metadata.ts.spec.md
-    ├── build-pieces.mjs.spec.md
-    ├── check-islands.mjs.spec.md
-    ├── check-pieces.mjs.spec.md
-    ├── check-primitives.mjs.spec.md
-    ├── check-runtime.mjs.spec.md
-    └── lib/
-        ├── pieces-harness.mjs.spec.md
-        ├── preact-alias.mjs.spec.md
-        └── tag-contract.mjs.spec.md
```

No source file, test or setting changes. The "MCP Metadata" area stays in `_areas.md` although no spec uses it after this: it describes data the MCP server reads.

## Evidence

- **Before:** 121 specs on `main`, 10 of them for files outside the four code folders.
  **After:** 111 specs, 0 outside the four code folders.
- The current analysis (of `01bc3c8`, after the code folders changed) attaches 0 of its 118 requirements to the 10 deleted specs (SPEC-001 to 004, 011, 025, 061 to 064).
- Every requirement in the deleted specs carries `predictable:inferred`: Predictable derived them from the code, nobody wrote one by hand.
- No file outside `specs/` refers to the deleted specs or to the "Validation Checks" area.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

A revert restores the files. If the build and check scripts go back into the code folders, Predictable derives their specs again.

**Blast Radius:** docs

Only generated Markdown under `specs/`. The merge is a push to `main`, so it starts one Predictable sync and one run of its repository agent.

reason: Pull request merged is not an event the agent reacts to
